@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+name: ZEUS repository intelligence format probe
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - codex/zeus-repository-intelligence-integration-v1
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  prettier:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
+        with:
+          version: 9.0.0
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: 20
+          cache: pnpm
+      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
+      - name: Print canonical Prettier diff
+        run: |
+          pnpm exec prettier --write scripts/zeus-impact.mjs scripts/zeus-repository-intelligence-integration.test.mjs
+          git diff -- scripts/zeus-impact.mjs scripts/zeus-repository-intelligence-integration.test.mjs

@@ -5,8 +5,13 @@ on:
     paths:
       - '.zeus/repository-graph.json'
       - '.zeus/repository-graph-declarations.json'
+      - 'scripts/zeus.mjs'
+      - 'scripts/zeus-fast-compile.mjs'
+      - 'scripts/zeus-impact.mjs'
+      - 'scripts/lib/zeus-repository-evidence.mjs'
       - 'scripts/zeus-repository-intelligence.mjs'
       - 'scripts/zeus-repository-intelligence.test.mjs'
+      - 'scripts/zeus-repository-intelligence-integration.test.mjs'
       - '.github/workflows/zeus-repository-intelligence.yml'
       - 'packages/**'
       - 'apps/web/**'
@@ -44,7 +49,11 @@ jobs:
       - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
 
       - name: Check repository intelligence syntax
-        run: node --check scripts/zeus-repository-intelligence.mjs
+        run: |
+          node --check scripts/zeus-repository-intelligence.mjs
+          node --check scripts/lib/zeus-repository-evidence.mjs
+          node --check scripts/zeus-fast-compile.mjs
+          node --check scripts/zeus-impact.mjs
 
       - name: Run repository intelligence regressions
         run: node --test scripts/zeus-repository-intelligence.test.mjs
@@ -55,6 +64,9 @@ jobs:
       - name: Require fresh repository graph
         run: node scripts/zeus-repository-intelligence.mjs --json status
 
+      - name: Run compile and impact integration regressions
+        run: node scripts/zeus-repository-intelligence-integration.test.mjs
+
       - name: Preflight canonical semantic model
         run: node scripts/zeus-repository-intelligence.mjs --json preflight packages/bim-core

@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@ const map = {
   evidence: 'zeus-evidence.mjs',
   index: 'zeus-index.mjs',
   context: 'zeus-context.mjs',
+  graph: 'zeus-repository-intelligence.mjs',
   impact: 'zeus-impact.mjs',
   check: 'zeus-check.mjs',
   validate: 'zeus-validate.mjs',
